framework_labels: MITRE ATT&CK | T1068 | Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
PRIVILEGE ESCALATION

DESCRIPTION:
Privilege escalation occurs when attackers gain permissions beyond those originally granted, allowing them to obtain administrator, root, or domain-level access. This often enables persistence, lateral movement, and complete system compromise.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1068 | Exploitation for Privilege Escalation

INDICATORS:
- Unexpected administrator accounts
- Unauthorized privilege assignments
- Privileged process execution
- Security control bypasses
- Abnormal administrative actions

DETECTION RULES:
- Unexpected privilege assignments
- Administrative process execution
- Unauthorized account modifications

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Servers
- Domain Controllers
- Administrative workstations
title: PRIVILEGE ESCALATION
